distinct_neighbour.scope: Two opening steel sashes under the hipped/brown roof of the 327–329 group. Different registered number and photograph. The 335 and 337 gates flank their own adjacent row; the neighbouring 333 entry with stone gate piers separates it from the 327–329 group. The 831 source has no city-feature assignment.

gate_roles.337: West small black garden door, green 337 on the left pillar. Opposite side of the included roughcast wall from the courtyard gate at 335.
gate_roles.335: East small garden door, green 335 on the right pillar by its red timber enclosed return window. Documented boundary and reference for a separate future segment; excluded from 337 geometry.
gate_roles.333: A further independent opening directly east of the 335 pedestrian gate, visibly wider, with two large ornamental gate piers.
gate_roles.central_door_pair: Two narrow arched doors in the 2017 view have no legible address numbers.
gate_roles.other_214: 陕西南路214 has a different named register row. No street tile was assigned by name alone.
